decision_skill.name: validated_seasonality_gate
decision_skill.description: Admit a seasonal component only when it repeatedly outperforms a robust nonseasonal baseline in recent rolling-origin validation.
decision_skill.applicability: When considering a calendar-aligned lag or seasonal blend for a time-series forecast with enough history for multiple non-overlapping validation blocks.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Compare the seasonal candidate against a robust level baseline using the target evaluation loss across several recent validation blocks; assign seasonal weight only if it wins consistently across a clear majority of blocks, otherwise set its weight to zero.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when history is too short for repeated validation, the candidate lag is not calendar-compatible, validation blocks overlap materially, or known interventions make recent backtests unrepresentative of the forecast horizon.
